personality_one_liner: A distraction-free, highly legible reading utility that stays out of the way of the content.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list items should feel touch-friendly, never cramped.

do's: Use frosted glass on the top pinned header over the overlay image viewer.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass for floating action buttons.
dont's: Do not use glass for the text translation bubbles (they need maximum solid contrast).
Do not blur standard list rows.

screens.name: Translate Screen (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary workflow to pick an image, configure language, and initiate translation.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a 'Detecting text...' caption.
states.empty: A prominent dashed-border dropzone or illustration encouraging the user to select an image from the gallery or camera.
states.error: Message 'Failed to read image' with a 'Try Again' CTA.

screens.layout: Top section: A sleek, pill-shaped Language Selector row (Source -> Target). Middle: A large empty state area (dashed upload block). Bottom: A sticky primary CTA to 'Select Image' wrapped in a bottom safe-area container.

screens.name: Language Selector (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: A quick selection modal for changing source or target languages.
screens.layout: A drag-handle bottom sheet. Top: 'Auto-detect' featured as a distinct, primary choice. Below: A clean single-column list of supported languages (English, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish, Russian) with a checkmark for the active selection. Solid surface background.

screens.name: Overlay Result View
screens.purpose: Full-screen viewer displaying the original image with translated text bubbles overlaid at their exact coordinates.

states.loading: Skeleton placeholders pulsing over the detected bounding boxes before the translation resolves.
states.empty: Toast: 'No text detected in this image.'

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge image view. A glassmorphic top header containing a 'Back' button and 'Share' button. Translation bubbles are rendered as absolutely positioned Views over the image using 'surfaceInverse' backgrounds for maximum contrast against manga/game art. Tapping a bubble morphs it or reveals a tooltip showing the original untranslated text.

screens.name: History Screen

states.empty: Illustration of blank polaroids with text 'No translations yet'.
states.error: Message 'Failed to load history' with 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Standard single-column list. Each row has a square thumbnail of the original image (left), the translated snippet or filename (title), and date (subtitle). Tap row to reopen Overlay Result View.

screens.name: Settings Screen
screens.purpose: User preferences for theme and default languages.
screens.layout: iOS-native style list. Group 1: Appearance (Light/Dark mode toggle). Group 2: Defaults (Interface Language, Default Source, Default Target). Group 3: About. Use tinted icon containers on the left of each row.

history_empty.alt: A simple composition of Polaroid-style frames on a white background.

manga_demo_hero.alt: Hands holding a manga book on a wooden table, showcasing artistic illustrations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette tokens. I have provided nested 'light' and 'dark' objects within 'color'. Map your theme provider to read these correctly.

Implement the 'Overlay Result View' translation bubbles using `surfaceInverse` as their background color and `onSurfaceInverse` for text. Since manga is often black and white (light backgrounds), and games can be dark, `surfaceInverse` guarantees it will pop heavily against standard reading materials.
In the Overlay Result View, the image MUST go edge-to-edge behind a glassmorphic top header (which houses the Back action).
For the Language Selector, implement it as a Bottom Sheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) rather than a full-screen navigation stack. 'Auto-detect' must be visually distinct from the manual language list.
No indigo, blue, purple, or generic AI colors were used. The brand color is a calm, earthy 'Moss Green' (`#5A7356`). Do not introduce blue or purple anywhere.
Use Phosphor icons. Outline weight for inactive states, Fill weight for active tab states. Settings rows should have icons wrapped in `brandTertiary` tinted rounded squares.
Ensure 'History' and 'Translate' screens have appropriate safe-area paddings at the bottom to avoid the bottom tabs overlaying content.
